items.title: Demolition of exhaust stack changes Stade skyline
items.summary: The 80-metre-high exhaust stack has been demolished at the decommissioned Stade nuclear power plant in Lower Saxony, Germany. Since 1970, the stack had been a prominent feature of the power plant's skyline and shaped the site for decades.
